programme.desc: A hired killer unknowingly makes friends with the man hes been sent to assassinate.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei was Hong Kongs most celebrated Queen of Kung-fu. Here she plays a swordswoman on a mission to avenge her parents murders and save the country from foreign invaders.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He doesnt believe in the rumors, but after running into a Taoist swordsman, he meets a beautiful lady ghost.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword masters daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu.

programme.title: Legend Of The Bat
programme.desc: Charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Hsiang, whose battlefield exploits rival his bedroom antics, travels to the Island of Bats, where he encounters monks, women and plenty of action!

programme.title: Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel by Jin Yong, havoc breaks out when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased master.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Peter Chen Ho is the suave playboy gallivanting across Asia, while having his way with three unsuspecting sisters, setting in motion a parade of mishaps and comic interludes.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: As a scholar and his lover are torn apart forever by his uncle and his friend, and drive the girl to commit suicide. The girl returns as ghost and seek revenge.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: The Sung Dynasty armys Chief Instructor is on a danger-fraught pilgrimage to the Tung Yueh Temple.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: The tale of two imperial concubines vying for the emperors favor.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua as a swordswoman out to reclaim her murdered husbands Green Sword, the sharpest blade in the world.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This film is a coming-of-age tale of the lower-class Hong Kong teens in the 1960s. Wang is the title character, a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Back in 1973 the stock market was skyrocketing, but HKs social issues continued to worsen. TVB and Shaw Bros biggest stars come together for this ingenious tongue-in-cheek tale.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: After killing a tiger, Wu Sung is appointed chief constable, but is soon drawn into a tragic love triangle between his ugly brother and her alluring wife, who tries to seduce him.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix is yet another masterpiece from director Li Han-hsiang. It is a comedy surrounded the upcoming marriage of the imperial ministers daughter.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: Chou Lian Huan is good at fist fighting in Shanghai. In order to please a hostess named Chen Ju Fang, he is willing to sacrifice everything and fight against the son of the gang leader in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Li Ching, the best actress of her era, play Ah Chiao is a girl from a rural village stranded in the city, who befriends a kind-hearted transient and a retired actor.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: What began as the sweet reunion of two high school friends quickly deteriorates into a deranged erotic nightmare when Rose takes a shine to former classmate Fang and her new fiance!

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Chen Hou is a chauffeur who gets caught in a mistaken identity scandal linking him to businesswoman Lok Dai. When a rumor gets out that the two are involved in an affair, shes angry and confronts him.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: An unknown film director who is pursuing his dream and unremittingly pursuing a career in film.

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: Ho Sau, an undercover agent, has been working with Yau, a drug lord, for years, but his job and family are in trouble.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Daily’s Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence, landslides, and put a town nearby are at stake. Will the authority blow up the tunnel?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Flirting Scholar 2
programme.desc: The movie tells the story of Tang Bo Hu and his three buddies before they become the four great talents in Jiangnan. Tang Bo Hu encounters a beautiful girl when studying in a monastery and they quickly fall in love, but her hidden identity is accidentally unveiled when Tang and friends uncover a conspiracy at the monastery.

programme.title: The Chosen One
programme.desc: Ah Jie has a special power - he can see ghosts and exorcise them. But unlike most superheroes, he has tried all ways and means to avoid using his powers to help those in need.

programme.title: Table For Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: Gao Haojun, an international security expert, is hijacked by gunmen on the first flight of A380 airliner, and his blind daughter is one of the undercover hostages, a fact that he doesnt know.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: The Way We Keep Dancing
programme.desc: This sequel of The Way We Dance features the plight of Hong Kongs grassroots performing artists as they fight against the governments plan to gentrify an industrial district where they settled in.

programme.title: Burning Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed during a mission, a narcotics team falls apart. Two survivors reunite to avenge their fallen comrades and uncover the real traitor.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: A prosecutor on his last case deals with a colleague to exonerate a suspect, making the law just.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighboring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Eva’s mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mother’s wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Eva’s heart?

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon
programme.desc: Crippled Ho came to Hong Kong as an illegal immigrant in 1963 and ruthlessly carved an empire from the chaotic underworld of drug dealers and corrupt police that ruled the city under notorious detective Lee Rock.

programme.title: Man On The Edge
programme.desc: The triad gang leader assigns Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor who joins the investigation finds Chois actions suspicious.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong’s biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching’s wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Marrying Mr. Perfect
programme.desc: Winnie is dumped by her boyfriend in her late twenties and unknowingly meets Koo, a ruthless tycoon in business and a playboy. Koo temporarily switches identities with his driver for security reason and falls for Winnie as she is the first girl to love him for who he is. What will happen when Winnie know Koo’s real identity?

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Fat, who suffers from amnesia, believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters best ally.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: The Infernal Walker
programme.desc: Ting is an undercover police who infiltrates a triad and Tuen is a triad mole being planted into the police force. While Tang is tired of being an undercover cop, Tuen wishes to quit the triad and become a real police. When the triad boss sets a trap to uncover the moles identity, the two must fight for themselves.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Chen and his partner Guan are legendary navigators, but in the process of helping a girl Xiao Yu, they must also face their own problems.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: A wealthy entrepreneur goes undercover with an Interpol agent to protect a new invention, the Seed of God, from falling into an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar owner befriends a drunken woman and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs.

programme.desc: A Bite of China is a Chinese documentary series directed by Chen Xiaoqing, first aired on May 14, 2012, on CCTV. The seven-episode series explores the history, traditions, and stories behind foods from across mainland China, Macau, and Hong Kong

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The films story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the groups leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.desc: After Po is tapped to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace, he needs to find and train a new Dragon Warrior, while a wicked sorceress plans to re-summon all the master villains whom Po has vanquished to the spirit realm.

programme.title: Hafizah
programme.desc: Since childhood, Hafizah ( Olivia Jensen ) has lived in an orphanage without knowing who her parents are. Many people like her simple, cheerful and tomboyish attitude. Unfortunately, on her 18th birthday, Hafizah had to leave the orphanage according to applicable regulations. Hafizahs life changed. He is invited to work at the house of Widuri ( Ade Irawan ), a rich grandmother who is known for being fierce and angry. Hafizahs outspoken attitude resulted in her often clashing with Widuri. Surya ( Ferry Salim ), Widuris son, and wife, Vani ( Cut Tari ), persuade Hafizah to feel at home working. In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.
